description:
### Gboard Enhancement Patches Suite v1.4.2

#### 🐛 Fixes in v1.4.2
- **Fix Glide Trail Custom Color Reflection:** Resolved an inverted branch condition (`if-gez` -> `if-ltz`) in `GestureOverlayView.morpheOnDrawHook` timing calculation which was prematurely returning and permanently blocking `morpheApplyCustomTrailSettings` from executing and applying the custom color during glide typing.
- **Synchronous Dual-Context Storage:** Upgraded preference saving in `GlideTrailPreferences` to synchronously `.commit()` values to both default and Device-Encrypted (DE) storage contexts so preferences are immediately visible across all Gboard processes.
- **Mutual Exclusivity:** Choosing a custom color in `ColorWheelDialog` automatically disables Rainbow RGB mode so your chosen color is immediately displayed without conflicting rainbow cycles.
- **View Lifecycle Hook:** Added an active hook on `GestureOverlayView.onSizeChanged` to proactively reload and apply custom settings whenever the keyboard view is displayed or resized.

#### ✨ Included Patches
- **Backspace Repeat Haptic Feedback**: Delivers continuous tactile pulses on each repeated character deletion when holding down the backspace key.
- **Enter Key Tasker Event**: Dispatches high-priority Android Intent broadcasts to Tasker on Enter/IME actions.
- **Glide Trail Customization**: Color Wheel picker, continuous duration/width/length sliders, and dynamic Rainbow RGB effect.

#### 📱 Add or Refresh in Morphe App
1. Open **Morphe** on your Android device.
2. Go to **Settings** -> **Sources** -> Refresh sources (or add `https://github.com/ausamnco/gboard-enc-patches`).
3. Repatch Gboard and enjoy!
